projects.name: Tune For 2
projects.description:
A commercial e-commerce platform that allows customers to commission professional, personalized songs as unique gifts for birthdays, anniversaries, and special occasions. This project involved creating a seamless frontend experience to capture complex customer requirements and streamline the custom song creation process.
Technologies Used: 
React.js, JavaScript (ES6+), Responsive CSS, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Ant Design.

Key Contributions & Outcomes:
Dynamic User Interface: Engineered a responsive, multi-step order form with real-time input validation and clear progress indicators, simplifying the process of specifying song details, recipient information, and personalized lyrics.

Seamless Integration: Built the frontend to consume RESTful APIs from a Node.js/Express.js backend, ensuring reliable data submission for order processing and secure file uploads for reference materials.

Professional UX/UI: Implemented a clean, visually engaging user interface using modern CSS practices and components from Ant Design, ensuring an optimal experience across all device types (desktop, tablet, mobile).
Project Outcome: Delivered a client-facing application that serves as the primary sales channel for a custom music service, handling the entire customer journey from product discovery to order confirmation.
